items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S255

SPONSOR: KENNEDY
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the education law, in relation to developing guidelines
to encouraging participation in apprenticeships and raising awareness in
apprenticeship opportunities

 
PURPOSE:

To ensure that high school students in New York are made aware of
apprenticeship and trade opportunities.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section one directs the commissioner, in consultation with the depart-
ment of labor and pupil personnel advocates, develop guidelines for use
by high school guidance counselors in making students aware of appren-
ticeship opportunities and encouraging student participation in appren-
ticeships.

Section two sets the effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Every year many jobs in New York go unfilled because of the lack of
workers with the appropriate skills necessary to fill those jobs.  Many
of these jobs are in the building, construction, manufacturing, and
maritime trades. Often times, apprenticeships are the best way to
receive the skills necessary to obtain such jobs. Raising awareness
about such apprenticeship opportunities at the high school level allows
students the chance to potentially participate in an apprenticeship and
gain valuable work skills and life experience as they consider their
future educational and/or work path beyond high school, and for busi-
nesses to fill middle-skill jobs that are needlessly left vacant.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Requires the commissioner of education to develop guidelines to encourage those in high school to participate in apprenticeships and to raise awareness in apprenticeship opportunities.
title: Requires the commissioner of education to develop guidelines to encourage participation in apprenticeships
